prompts.categories:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production sprite atlas for the BUILD category strip of a 2016 illustrated Flash baseball game.
Reference image: screenshot of original Baseball Heroes BUILD, use only the small illustrated category symbols along its bottom bar as visual/style reference. Do not reproduce the screenshot or its blue interface.
Create exactly nine isolated small game icons on a genuinely transparent canvas, in an evenly spaced 3-column by 3-row grid, each fully inside its own square cell with generous transparent padding. Crisp dark ink outlines, hand-drawn Flash/cartoon illustration, subtle highlights and bevels on physical objects, compact readable silhouettes. These are tiny category illustrations, not modern rounded app tiles or flat line icons. No labels, letters, numbers, UI panels, background, checkerboard or drop-shadow rectangle.
Row 1 left to right: BACKGROUND: small tropical palm tree and two little city/stadium buildings as in the original second BUILD icon; FIELD: green baseball diamond with sandy basepaths and small bright white bases; SCOREBOARD: compact black electronic scoreboard with metallic grey casing, tiny yellow score lights, two short legs, no text.
Row 2: STAND: a compact tiered red-brown stadium bleacher section with silver rails, like the original; FENCE: a short teal metal baseball fence with two gold-capped upright posts and a small colored advertising plate without text; LIGHTS: a silver lattice floodlight tower with a rectangle of small cream lamps, like the original.
Row 3: DECOR: gold pennant on a silver pole on a small weighted circular base; BANNER: a folded red-and-gold cloth advertising pennant strung between two small posts, clearly different from the metal fence; WALL: a solid teal padded stadium wall section with a cap rail, thick segmented cushions and a concrete foot.
All nine drawings share the same stroke weight and frontal/slight isometric camera of the original symbols. Center each drawing in its grid cell. Icons must not touch, no diagonally cast shadow extending outside the cell. Transparent background.
prompts.decorations:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent stadium-decoration sprite atlas for an illustrated Flash baseball game.
Reference 1: original Baseball Heroes BUILD screenshot for the compact cartoon Flash world and its physical stadium props. Reference 2: new category atlas, match its crisp dark outlines, metallic edge highlights, small controlled gradients and bright colors. Do not copy a UI or any background.
Draw exactly FIVE isolated placeable decoration props, equally spaced in a SINGLE horizontal row, all on the same ground baseline. Each fits fully in one of five equal square cells, with generous transparent margin. No text, no labels, no panels, no visible grid, no backdrop, no checkerboard. All silhouettes must be separated. Frontal to slight isometric view, consistent line weight, readable at 60 pixels tall, polished small Flash-game sprites rather than realistic 3D objects.
From left to right: 1) a red triangular victory pennant on a silver pole with gold tip and weighted dark-grey circular base; 2) a large golden five-point star standing on a small dark blue display pedestal with gold trim; 3) an oversized white baseball with clear red stitched seams sitting on a low blue-grey display base; 4) a gold baseball championship trophy with two curled handles, a little baseball medallion on the cup, stem and two-tier dark pedestal, no writing; 5) a compact fireworks launch tower with three colorful upright rocket tubes, purple/silver metal support frame and a small stylized golden spark above, visibly a stationary decoration, no smoke cloud covering its edges.
Keep clean outlines, reflections and small contact shadows immediately attached to each prop, no wide shadow stretching into neighboring cells. Entire surrounding canvas genuinely transparent. These props are reconstructed art, not recovered originals.

processing: Generated atlases copied unchanged into the project. Frame rectangles measured from alpha; runtime creates shared small bitmaps.
